description: This file defines a singleton object `PermissionHelper` that manages runtime permission checks and requests for an Android application, specifically handling permissions related to Bluetooth, media access, and location. It provides methods to verify permission statuses, request permissions, and determine required permissions based on Android API levels.

classes.name: PermissionHelper
classes.description: A singleton object that encapsulates permission checking and requesting logic for Bluetooth, media, and location permissions.

methods.name: hasAllPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the application has all the required permissions granted in the current context.

methods.name: requestAllPermissions
methods.description: Requests all necessary permissions from the user via the provided activity and request code.

methods.name: requiredPermissions
methods.description: Determines the list of permissions required based on the device's API level.
